data.title: Mr. AbdulHamid Quritem Interactive Chemistry Platform
data.subtitle: Lessons & Monthly Packages, Auto-Graded/Randomized Exams, General & Azhari Homework Videos, Coupons & Multi-Payment Checkout
data.short_description: A bilingual chemistry learning platform featuring lessons, monthly packages, auto-graded and randomized exams, separate general and Azhari homework videos, coupons, multi-gateway payments, and a full admin dashboard.
data.description: Engineered a bilingual (Arabic and English) chemistry learning platform for high school students supporting grade levels, individual lessons, and monthly packages (with optional discounts and comprehensive package exams), complete with PDFs, protected lesson videos, and dedicated homework videos for general and Azhari education tracks. The platform includes an exam engine with unlimited questions, configurable random question counts per attempt, automatic grading, and detailed results (percentage, score, correct/wrong counts, and pass/fail status), alongside blogs, messaging, a student profile (profile editing, purchased lessons/packages, and WhatsApp inquiries to the instructor), multi-channel payments (mobile wallets, Fawry, Aman, Visa/Mastercard, Apple Pay, and Basata) plus coupons, and a comprehensive admin panel managing roles, admins, students (general/Azhari), access duration/expiry controls, media, and platform settings.

challenge.title: Tailoring Content & Homework by Grade and General/Azhari Track
challenge.description: Filtering lessons and packages by grade level and delivering dedicated homework videos for general vs. Azhari students while protecting lesson videos and PDFs.

challenge.title: Packages, Randomized Exams & Post-Purchase Expiry Rules
challenge.description: Coordinating packages, discounts, and package-wide exams alongside randomized exam questions, auto-grading, detailed score breakdowns, and access duration controls.

challenge.title: Multi-Gateway Checkout, Unlimited Coupons & Bilingual Admin
challenge.description: Integrating mobile wallets, Fawry, Aman, cards, Apple Pay, and Basata with unlimited coupons, payment logs, and bilingual role/content management.

data.solution: Structured the platform into clear modules separating grade levels and student profiles/tracks (general or Azhari) from lessons and their attachments (lesson video, PDF, and general/Azhari homework videos) and monthly packages with discounts, built an exam engine supporting random question selection, automated grading, and detailed result breakdowns, enforced post-purchase access duration controls, and integrated payment gateways, coupons, role-based admin controls, and Arabic/English localization.
data.results: Delivered a bilingual chemistry learning platform featuring lessons and monthly packages, auto-graded and randomized exams, general and Azhari homework videos, access-duration controls, multi-gateway payments and coupons, and a full admin, instructor, and student experience.

data.title: Dr. KROK Comprehensive Medical & Dental Learning Platform (Ukraine)
data.subtitle: Video, Live & Center Courses, Quizzes & Study Tracker, Medical Store, Promo Codes & Device Security
data.short_description: A large-scale bilingual (English & Ukrainian) medical and dental learning platform uniting courses, quizzes, study tracking, and device controls with a medical store (books, booklets, tools, apparel), flash offers, promo codes, and full admin management.
data.description: Engineered the Dr. KROK learning and commerce platform in English and Ukrainian for dental, medical, and pharmacy students from early academic years through internship and KROK exam preparation in Ukraine. The platform combines recorded video courses, live courses, and center courses, interactive tests and score tracking, a study tracker and daily attendance log (streaks, study time, and adherence rates), referral and points balances, and device-security controls (registered devices, device change history with IP tracking, and monthly change-limit resets). It also includes a store for books, booklets, medical tools, and medical apparel, flash offers, promo codes and coupons, order and transaction pipelines, vacancies and blogs, and a comprehensive admin panel covering students, instructors/merchants, roles, universities, cities, branches, university student tracking, and platform maintenance.

challenge.title: Multi-Mode Learning, Testing, Study Tracking & Universities
challenge.description: Coordinating video, live, and center courses, exams and results, daily study logs, and university student tracking across specializations and academic years

challenge.title: Diverse Orders, Medical Store, Offers, Promo Codes & Points
challenge.description: Managing course, book, booklet, medical tool, and apparel orders alongside flash offers, promo codes, coupons, points, and transactions accurately

challenge.title: Device Change Controls, Account Security & Bilingual Scale
challenge.description: Enforcing registered device tracking, device change history and monthly limits, and account protection across English and Ukrainian with role controls.

data.solution: Structured the platform into connected modules separating video, live, and center courses, quizzes, daily study logs, and university tracking from the store (books, booklets, medical tools, and apparel), flash offers, promo codes, orders, and transactions, while incorporating device tracking and change-limit controls, role/user/instructor/merchant management, and English and Ukrainian localization across frontend and admin[cite: 54, 56, 60, 61].
data.results: Delivered the Dr. KROK learning and commerce platform in English and Ukrainian for dental, medical, and pharmacy students, uniting courses, quizzes, study tracking, medical store items, flash offers, promo codes, device security, and admin management.

data.description: Engineered the Dr. KROK PLUS interactive testing and study platform in English and Ukrainian for medical students in Ukraine, enabling students to launch sessions in study or exam mode with progress tracking, solved question counts, timers, scores, exit-attempt tracking, session continuation, and result review. The platform also provides multi-tier subscription plans with pricing, discounts, and durations, coupons and financial transactions, and an admin panel managing users, roles, granular permissions, academic hierarchies (specializations, subjects, systems, topics, years), real-time activity streams, mail notifications, and contact settings.
